description: This is not your average condo. Tucked away on the second floor of a classic Spanish-style building in the heart of Toluca Lake, this condo has been reimagined into a bespoke, Scandi-modern sanctuary. This 3-bedroom residence is defined by bright, open-concept spaces and highly curated, designer details. The Kitchen is a Masterclass in Design where the owners spared no expense. They created a seamless chef's kitchen featuring flat-panel custom cabinetry, elegant stone countertops, stunning tile backsplash, and custom pendant lights. Brushed gold hardware and a coordinating gooseneck faucet are elevated details. Open shelving over the dedicated dry bar/espresso station offsets the clean lines, and features a built-in wine cooler for effortless hosting. Entertaining Made Easy | The layout flows naturally through the living spaces with wood floors and terrazzo tiles, toward a charming Juliet balcony nook. It's an ideal, private space for a vertical garden or a quiet coffee. Spa-Inspired Bathrooms | The primary suite is a true retreat. It leads into a bathroom sanctuary anchored by a deep soaking tub, extra large shower and a double sink vanity with plenty of counter space in between. The Heart of Toluca Lake | Located steps from iconic Riverside Drive, this property offers incredible walkability to the neighborhood's storied dining and boutique shopping. Move-in-ready, highly polished, and impossible to find at this level of finish. This is the new standard of Toluca Lake living. Additional Details | Plenty of storage in the form of a front hall closet, a full-size laundry room, a linen closet, and a custom primary walk-in closet. Must-Have EV charger in the garage, as well as a storage locker and bike room.
